Community Social Platform

Welcome to the next-generation community social platform designed for students, creators, and professionals to connect, share updates, save important content, and compete on the leaderboard.

Application Tabs

  • Hangout – Community discussion and social interaction space.
  • Updates – Latest announcements and trending updates.
  • Bookmarks – Saved posts and important resources.
  • Leaderboard – Top active members ranked by engagement.

1. Hangout Section

The Hangout tab acts as the main social feed where users can interact with community members in real time.

Features

  1. Create text posts
  2. Upload images and media
  3. Like and comment on posts
  4. Follow trending discussions
  5. Search community topics

Sample Post Card

🚀 UI Design Challenge

Today we started a new UI challenge for community members. Share your best mobile app designs and win leaderboard points.

  • 👍 245 Likes
  • 💬 48 Comments
  • 🔖 19 Saves

2. Updates Section

The Updates tab displays all important notifications, announcements, events, and release notes in a clean card layout.

Latest Updates

  • Version 2.0 Released

    New dark mode and leaderboard animations added.

  • Community Event

    Join the weekend hackathon and earn bonus points.

  • Maintenance Notice

    Server maintenance scheduled for Sunday 2:00 AM.

3. Bookmarks Section

Users can save useful content and access it later from the bookmarks section.

Saved Content Types

  • Saved Posts
  • Important Announcements
  • Community Resources
  • Leaderboard Highlights

Empty State Example

You do not have any saved bookmarks yet. Start saving important posts to view them here later.

4. Leaderboard Section

The Leaderboard encourages healthy competition by ranking users based on their activity, engagement, and achievements.

3Michael Smith🥉 Silver9,875

Design Requirements

  • Modern mobile-first layout
  • Responsive UI for all devices
  • Bottom navigation bar
  • Dark and light mode support
  • Rounded cards with soft shadows
  • Animated transitions and hover effects
  • Modern typography and spacing

Technology Stack

  • React.js
  • Tailwind CSS
  • Reusable Component Architecture
  • REST API Integration
Goal: Create a highly engaging community platform that combines social networking, updates, bookmarking, and gamification into one modern experience.
